title: Is AI coming for my job?

safe.title: An AI that works for you
safe.subtitle: how Divina works

end.name: Divina
end.tagline: Your screen, turned into a room.

lines.text: Divina, be straight with me. Everyone online says AI's coming for all the jobs. Is it coming for mine?
What do you actually do all day?
Emails. Meetings about the emails. Then a spreadsheet about the meetings.
Right. I'm not taking your job. I'm taking the bits of it you hate.
The parts that need a human. Talking to people, making the call, and noticing when the spreadsheet's wrong.
And if the boss decides a robot's cheaper?
Then the boss can sit in the meeting that should've been an email. With the robot.
Fair. So where do I even start?
With an AI that works for you, not your boss. I run on your own computer, your keys stay encrypted, and I'm free.
Free, and on my own computer. Does it come with a pay rise?
No. But I'll remind you to ask for one.
Divina. Free for Windows, Mac and Linux coming soon. divinaos.site.
lines.say: Divina. Free for Windows, Mac and Linux coming soon. Divina O S dot site.
